a1.label: 1. In RAID 1, the data...
a1.why: The text says the drives are mirrored in a RAID 1 configuration.

a2.label: 2. Option B is better for virtualisation because...
a2.why: The text says Option B has 128 GB of RAM, better for running virtual machines.

a3.label: 3. Workstations are connected to...
a3.why: The text says all workstations are connected to a central switch.

a4.label: 4. LAN/internet traffic is managed by...
a4.why: The text says the router manages traffic between the LAN and the internet.

a5.label: 5. The firewall's job is to...
a5.why: The text says the firewall filters incoming traffic.

a6.label: 6. T. Krüger recommends...
a6.why: The text says the recommendation is Option B.

b1.label: 1. The 'brain' of the computer
b1.why: The CPU is the 'brain' that executes instructions.

b2.label: 2. Lost when the computer is switched off
b2.why: Data in RAM is lost when the computer is switched off.

b3.label: 3. No moving parts, faster than a hard drive
b3.why: An SSD has no moving parts and is much faster than a traditional hard drive.

b4.label: 4. Forwards data packets between networks
b4.why: The router forwards data packets between different networks.

b5.label: 5. Connects devices inside the office
b5.why: Inside the office, devices are connected through a switch.

b6.label: 6. Computers in the building share the same ___
b6.why: All computers in the building belong to the same LAN.

b7.label: 7. Video conferences use a lot of ___
b7.why: Video conferences use a lot of bandwidth.

c1.label: 1. Data ___ between the two drives
c1.why: ‘Data’ is treated as singular here, so the passive uses ‘is mirrored’.

c2.label: 2. The servers ___ in a locked room
c2.why: ‘Servers’ is plural, so the passive uses ‘are kept’.

c3.label: 3. Incoming traffic ___ by the firewall
c3.why: ‘Traffic’ is singular/uncountable, so the passive uses ‘is filtered’.

c4.label: 4. Backups ___ every night
c4.why: ‘Backups’ is plural, so the passive uses ‘are created’.

c5.label: 5. The network ___ by two administrators
c5.why: ‘The network’ is singular, so the passive uses ‘is managed’.

c6.label: 6. New hardware ___ before it is installed
c6.why: ‘Hardware’ is singular/uncountable, so the passive uses ‘is tested’.

c7.label: 7. IP addresses ___ automatically
c7.why: ‘IP addresses’ is plural, so the passive uses ‘are assigned’.
